recipes.title: Crispy Garlic Butter Parmesan Chicken Bites

items.i: boneless skinless chicken breast, bite-sized pieces
extra Parmesan, parsley, red pepper flakes, lemon wedges

steps: Pat the chicken dry and cut into even 1–1½-inch pieces so they cook evenly.
Whisk the buttermilk, pickle juice, egg white, garlic powder, paprika, onion powder, salt and pepper. Toss in the chicken, cover and refrigerate 1–4 hours.
Combine the flour, crushed panko, cornstarch, Parmesan and seasonings in a shallow bowl.
Lift the chicken out one piece at a time, let the excess drip off, and press firmly into the coating, squeezing to make craggy bits. Rest on a wire rack 5 minutes.

Preheat the air fryer to 200 °C (390 °F) and spray the basket. Cook in a single layer, spraying the tops so no dry flour remains, 10–14 minutes, flipping halfway, until golden and 74 °C (165 °F) inside. Work in batches.
Melt the light butter over low heat and gently cook the garlic 30–45 seconds until fragrant. Take off the heat.
Whisk the yogurt, milk, Parmesan, lemon juice, Italian seasoning, garlic powder, parsley, salt and pepper, then stir in the garlic butter. Loosen with a splash of milk if needed.
Toss the hot bites with just enough sauce to coat (or brush it on), then top with parsley, pepper and extra Parmesan. Serve right away.
recipes.notes: From your recipe doc. Time excludes the 1–4 hour marinade. Macros assume most of the marinade is discarded and some breading is left over. Meal prep: store chicken and sauce separately up to 3 days; reheat the chicken in the air fryer at 175 °C (350 °F) for 3–5 minutes, then sauce it.

recipes.title: Creamy Spicy Parmesan Protein Vodka Pasta

items.i: fresh basil, extra Parmesan, red pepper flakes

steps: Boil the pasta in well-salted water until al dente. Save about ¾ cup pasta water, then drain.
Blend the cottage cheese, Greek yogurt, cream cheese and milk 30–60 seconds until completely smooth.
Heat the oil in a large nonstick skillet over medium-low and cook the onion 4–5 minutes until soft.
Add the garlic, red pepper flakes, Italian seasoning, paprika and garlic powder; cook 30–60 seconds.
Stir in the tomato paste, spread it over the pan and cook over medium 3–4 minutes, stirring, until brick-red.
Lower the heat, add the vodka and stir 1–2 minutes, scraping the pan. No vodka? Use 2 tbsp pasta water.
Add ¼ cup pasta water, let the pan cool slightly on the lowest heat, then stir in the blended cottage cheese mixture until smooth.
Stir in the Parmesan gradually. Don't let it boil or the dairy can separate.
Loosen with pasta water to a silky, pourable sauce and season with salt, pepper and extra chili.
Toss the pasta in the sauce over very low heat 1–2 minutes. Serve topped with basil, Parmesan and pepper.
recipes.notes: From your recipe doc. Macros assume high-protein pasta, fat-free cottage cheese and reduced-fat cream cheese. Meal prep: keeps 3 days; reheat gently with a splash of milk or water.

recipes.title: Fluffy Chocolate Chip Protein Pancakes

items.i: strawberries, sugar-free maple syrup, powdered sweetener, extra chips

steps: Whisk the flour, protein powder, baking powder, baking soda, sweetener and salt.
In another bowl mix the Greek yogurt, egg whites, almond milk and vanilla until smooth.
Fold the wet into the dry until just combined — thick but spoonable. Don't overmix.
Fold in the chocolate chips (save a few for the tops) and rest the batter 5 minutes.
Spray a nonstick skillet over medium-low heat. Add a sixth of the batter per pancake, piled high, not spread. Cover and cook 2–3 minutes until the edges set and bubbles appear.
Flip and cook 1–2 minutes more until golden and cooked through. Serve warm with your toppings.
recipes.notes: From your recipe doc: about 105 cal and 9 g protein per pancake (630 cal, 54 g protein for the batch). Carbs and fat are my estimates. Tips: keep the heat medium-low, use a lid, and add a splash of almond milk if the batter is too thick.

recipes.title: Creamy Garlic Parmesan Lemon Protein Pasta

items.i: dry high-protein fusilli lunghi or rotini
extra Parmesan, parsley, lemon zest, red pepper flakes

steps: Boil the pasta in salted water until al dente. Save ½ cup pasta water, then drain.
Blend the cottage cheese, Greek yogurt, cream cheese and milk 30–60 seconds until silky.
Melt the light butter in a large nonstick skillet over medium-low and cook the garlic 30–60 seconds.
Add the onion powder, garlic powder, Italian seasoning, red pepper flakes and pepper; cook 30 seconds.
Lower the heat, add ¼ cup pasta water, let the pan cool slightly, then stir in the blended mixture until smooth.
Stir in the Parmesan gradually without letting it boil.
Take the pan off the heat, then stir in the lemon juice and zest. Season to taste.
Toss in the pasta, loosening with pasta water as needed. Top with parsley, Parmesan, zest and chili.
recipes.notes: From your recipe doc. Adding the lemon off the heat stops the sauce separating. Add grilled chicken or shrimp for even more protein (macros will change). Meal prep: keeps 3 days; reheat gently with a splash of milk or water.

recipes.title: Crispy Garlic Parmesan Chicken Shawarma Wraps

items.i: boneless skinless chicken breast, diced small

steps: Mix the yogurt, lemon juice, oil and all the spices, toss with the diced chicken and refrigerate at least 30 minutes (up to 4 hours).
Toss the onion, tomatoes, parsley, lemon juice, sumac, pepper and salt; set aside.
Whisk the sauce ingredients, adding water a little at a time until thick but drizzleable. Chill.
Sear the chicken in a sprayed nonstick skillet over medium-high in batches, 6–8 minutes, until golden and 74 °C (165 °F) inside.
Return all the chicken, lower the heat, scatter over the mozzarella, cover 1–2 minutes to melt, toss and add parsley.
Warm each tortilla in a dry pan 15–20 seconds per side.
Spread about 1 tbsp sauce on each tortilla, add a sixth of the chicken and a spoonful of salad (drained), fold in the sides and roll tightly.
Toast seam-side down in a sprayed pan over medium heat 2–3 minutes per side, pressing gently, until crisp. Rest 1 minute, slice and serve with extra sauce.
recipes.notes: From your recipe doc. Time excludes the 30-minute marinade. For extra crunch, use a panini press or air fry at 190 °C (375 °F) for 3–5 minutes. Meal prep: store chicken, salad and sauce separately up to 3 days; assemble and toast just before eating.

recipes.title: Chocolate Frosted Protein Donuts
steps: Stir all the donut base ingredients together into a smooth batter.
Lightly butter a 6-cavity donut pan. Spoon the batter into a zip-top bag, snip a corner and pipe it into the cavities.
Bake about 6 minutes and check; some ovens need up to 8. Don't overbake or they dry out.
While they bake, mix the frosting ingredients, adding water a little at a time until it's spreadable.
Let the donuts cool enough to handle, spoon the frosting on top, and eat.
recipes.notes: Recipe and macros come straight from the video description, so nothing here is estimated. You'll need a 6-cavity donut pan. Check your baking powder is labeled gluten-free if that matters to you.

recipes.title: Pasta alla Zucca (Pumpkin & Guanciale)
steps: Peel and dice the pumpkin into small cubes, finely chop the onion and cut the guanciale into strips.
Cook the guanciale in a dry pan over medium heat until golden and the fat has rendered.
Add the onion, pumpkin and rosemary to the fat and sauté a few minutes. Add the water, cover and cook until the pumpkin is soft, then mash it into a creamy sauce. Season with nutmeg and pepper.
Cook the pasta in well-salted water until al dente. Save about a cup of the pasta water before draining.
Toss the pasta into the sauce with a splash of pasta water. Off the heat, stir in the pecorino, adding more pasta water until it's glossy and creamy.
Plate with extra pecorino and black pepper.
recipes.notes: Ingredients come from the video description. The video has no narration, so the steps follow what's shown on screen, and servings, time and nutrition are estimates.

recipes.title: Creamy Gochujang Brothy Rice Bowl
steps: Blend the bone broth, cottage cheese and gochujang until completely smooth.
Microwave both bags of riced cauliflower, then mix in the jasmine rice while everything is hot. The rice soaks up the cauliflower's moisture and fluffs up.
Put the cold beef straight into a hot pan and flatten it with a spatula. Salt lightly and leave it alone 3–3½ minutes until a crust forms. Flip, crust the other side, then break it into pieces.
Turn the heat down to 4/10. Add the brown sugar, rice vinegar, soy sauce, miso and sesame oil. Stir, then press the beef flat again so it keeps crisping.
Warm the blended broth covered. Once bubbles reach the top, stir and simmer 2–3 more minutes.
Dice the cucumber and slice the green onion while the broth simmers.
Pack hot rice firmly into a cup and turn it out into the bowl. Add beef and cucumber, pour the creamy broth around it, and finish with green onion, sesame seeds and red pepper flakes.
recipes.notes: Calories and protein per bowl are as stated in the video. The beef amount, number of bowls and carbs/fat are estimates, since the video doesn't say them.

recipes.title: Mongolian Beef Ramen Stir-Fry

items.i: salt and a pinch of black pepper

items.note: ¾ for the sauce, ¼ for the slurry

steps: Put the vegetables in a hot pan, spread them flat and cover. About 3 minutes steams and chars them at once. Stir, flatten, repeat once. Add just one small pinch of salt, then set them aside.
Boil the noodles without the flavor packet and pull them well before done. Drain and run cold water over them so they don't go mushy.

Preheat the pan to 7/10 first. Add the cold beef, flatten it, salt lightly and add a pinch of pepper. Leave 3–4 minutes for a deep char, flip, char the other side, then break it into small pieces while it's still pink inside.
Add ¾ carton of broth, the soy sauce, hoisin, garlic, ginger, both sugars and red pepper flakes. Simmer about 3 minutes. It looks thin at first.
Whisk the remaining ¼ carton of broth (about 60 g) with the cornstarch until smooth. Stir it in and simmer 5–7 minutes until glossy.
Fold in the veggies, then the ramen, and toss until coated.
Top with green onion, sesame seeds and extra red pepper flakes if you like heat.
recipes.notes: Stated in the video as under 500 calories and 48 g protein per serving. Number of ramen packets, servings and carbs/fat are estimates.

recipes.title: Crispy Air-Fryer Beef Tacos
steps: Heat the pan to 7/10 with avocado oil. Add the onion and both peppers, press them flat and leave 2–3 minutes until you smell and see char.
Stir in the garlic until fragrant, then push everything to one side of the pan.
Smash the cold beef into the empty side. Don't touch it for about 3 minutes, flip (cut it in half to make it easier) and cook 2–3 minutes more, then break it up.
Add the taco seasoning and let it toast until the pan looks almost dry.
Lower the heat to 5/10. Add a splash of broth and the tomato paste so the beef soaks them up. Turn the heat off and stir in the Laughing Cow wedges.
On each tortilla: cheese, ⅙ of the filling, a little more cheese. Fold along the tortilla's built-in lines so it doesn't tear, and press firmly so the wet filling seals it shut.
Spray both sides. Air fry at 350°F for 3–5 minutes, flipping halfway.
Blend all the cilantro-lime sauce ingredients until smooth and serve alongside.
recipes.notes: 264 calories and 31 g protein per taco, as stated in the video. Beef amount and carbs/fat are estimates.

recipes.title: Smash Double Cheeseburger

items.i: yellow onion, sliced with the grain

steps: Cut off the top and root, halve it, then slice along the onion's lines (not across them).
Spray a hot pan, add the onion, press flat and cover to steam. Stir once it takes color. Add a few pinches of salt, then splashes of bone broth one at a time until deeply golden. Cover and set aside.
Set the bowl of beef on a scale, zero it, and pull out 3.3 oz at a time. That gives six pucks with no extra dishes. Freeze them 5 minutes.
Blend or whisk the yogurt, cottage cheese, ketchup, mayo, mustard, pickle juice, syrup and spices until smooth. Stir in the diced pickles.
Get the pan very hot (7/10). Set a puck down, cover with parchment and press hard for about 10 seconds. Don't salt the raw patty first; it draws out moisture.
Flip, add a cheese slice, and cover briefly to melt.
Bottom bun, sauce, two patties, caramelized onions, more sauce, top bun.
Lower the heat and press the whole burger in the pan to toast both sides of the bun.
recipes.notes: 530 calories and 54 g protein per double burger, as stated in the video. Carbs/fat are estimates.

recipes.title: Smash Cheeseburger with Honey-Soy Bacon
steps: The night before, coat the bacon in the honey and soy sauce in a bag and refrigerate overnight (up to 24 hours).
Blend all the burger sauce ingredients until smooth and season. It keeps 5 days in the fridge.
Heat the oven to 200°C (400°F) and line a tray. Gently mix the mince with the salt and some pepper and roll into four 125 g balls.
Bake the bacon 12 minutes, turning halfway. Sprinkle with the Parmesan and bake 2 minutes more.
Heat a heavy pan over high heat with 1 tbsp oil. Add two balls, cover with parchment and press down hard with a heavy pan or press until thin and lacy, under 1 cm.
Cook 2–3 minutes, flip, top each with a cheese slice and cook 1 minute more. Rest under loose foil and repeat with the remaining oil and beef.
Toast the cut sides of the buns in the pan for 1 minute. Spread with sauce, add sliced gherkins to the base, then two patties and the bacon. Serve straight away.
recipes.notes: Quantities, method and nutrition come from the full recipe on Waitrose's site, linked from the video. Nutrition is per burger as published by Waitrose.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Chickpea Chocolate Chip Cookies
steps: Heat the oven to 180°C / 350°F and line a baking tray with baking paper.
Blend the chickpeas, peanut butter, honey, vanilla and baking powder in a food processor until it's a smooth, thick cookie dough.
Divide into 12 portions on the tray, then shape and slightly flatten each one.
Bake 15–20 minutes until lightly golden on top.
Let them cool before eating; they firm up as they cool.
recipes.notes: Recipe and macros per cookie come from the video description. Use dairy-free chocolate chips to keep them fully plant-based.

recipes.title: Crispy Chocolate Almond Bites
steps: Heat the oven to 160°C / 320°F and line a large baking tray with baking paper.
Whisk the egg whites, powdered sugar, honey and vanilla together.
Fold in the almonds until evenly coated.
Spread in a thin, even layer on the tray, pressing it together into one slab.
Bake 20–25 minutes until golden and crisp at the edges.
While it's still hot, score into bite-size squares (about 2 inches). It sets fast, so do this straight away. Let it cool completely.
Melt the chocolate with the coconut oil in short microwave bursts, stirring between each.
Break into about 40 pieces, dip or drizzle each in chocolate, then chill in the fridge or freezer until set.
recipes.notes: Recipe and macros per piece come from the video description.

recipes.title: Chicken Crust Pizza Pocket
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C / 400°F and line a tray with baking paper.
Put the chicken mince between two sheets of baking paper and roll it into a thin, even oval. Season with garlic powder, Italian seasoning, salt and pepper.
Spread the passata over one half, leaving a border, then add the mozzarella and torn basil.
Use the paper to fold the other half over the filling and press the edges to seal.
Grate the Parmigiano over the top, press it in, and give it a light spray of oil.
Bake about 20 minutes, until the chicken reaches 74°C / 165°F inside.
Remove the baking paper (it can catch fire under the grill) and broil 2–10 minutes until deep golden.
recipes.notes: Recipe and macros come from the video description. Swap the filling for any pizza toppings you like.

recipes.title: Caramelised Roasted Sweet Potatoes
steps: Heat the oven to 190°C / 375°F and line a baking tray or dish with baking paper.
Wash and dry the sweet potatoes, trim the ends and slice them in half lengthways.
Toss with the olive oil, salt, pepper, garlic and smoked paprika, making sure the cut sides are well coated.
Place cut side down and bake 50 minutes. Don't flip or move them.
Leave them on the tray 30–45 minutes if you can (even 10 helps) so the caramelised layer stays on the potato instead of the paper.
Lift carefully with a thin spatula, caramelised side up.
recipes.notes: Recipe comes from the video description. Nutrition per half is an estimate; the creator didn't list it. Cook time doesn't include the optional rest.

recipes.title: Double Chocolate Chip Banana Bread
steps: Mash the bananas, then mix in the eggs, maple syrup, coconut oil and vanilla.
Add the almond flour, cocoa, tapioca flour, baking soda, cinnamon and salt and mix to a smooth batter.
Fold in half the chocolate chips, pour into a lined loaf tin and scatter the rest on top.
Bake at 180°C / 350°F for 40–50 minutes, until a toothpick in the middle comes out clean.
Let it cool, then cut into 10 slices.
recipes.notes: Recipe and macros per slice come from the video description. Any flour works instead of almond flour, but that changes the macros.

recipes.title: Sourdough French Toast Bake
steps: Toss the cubed sourdough with the melted butter. Heat the oven to 350°F.
Whisk the eggs, milk, salt, cinnamon and vanilla. Pour over the bread and let it sit 10–15 minutes to soak in.
Spread into a greased 8x10 pan or large cast-iron skillet. Top with the cinnamon sugar and pecans.
Bake 25–30 minutes, until the egg has set.
Serve warm with maple syrup, plus fruit or whipped cream if you like.
recipes.notes: Recipe from Tim's newsletter, linked from the video. Nutrition is an estimate (not including syrup).

recipes.title: Monster Cookie Protein Bites
steps: Stir the oats, peanut butter, honey, protein powder, M&M's, chocolate chips, vanilla and salt until evenly combined.
If it's still dry and crumbly after a minute of mixing, add applesauce 1 tbsp at a time until it holds together when squeezed.
Chill 20 minutes, then scoop with an ice cream scoop and roll into balls.
Refrigerate until firm, then keep covered (or they dry out). Fridge 1 week, freezer 2 months.
recipes.notes: Recipe from Tim's newsletter. Makes 22–24 bites; nutrition per bite is an estimate and depends on your protein powder.

recipes.title: Maple Sausage, Egg & Cheese Breakfast Sandwiches

items.note: or regular sausage + 1–2 tbsp maple syrup

steps: Heat the oven to 375°F and line or grease an 8-inch square pan.
Shape the sausage into 6 thin patties slightly wider than the muffins. Cook 3–4 minutes per side until browned and cooked through.
Whisk the eggs, milk, salt and pepper, pour into the pan and bake 12–16 minutes until just set. Cool slightly and cut into 6 squares.
Lightly toast the muffins if you like. Layer sausage, egg and cheddar on each bottom half and close.
Serve now, or cool completely before wrapping. Fridge 4 days, freezer 2 months. Reheat 60–90 seconds in the microwave, then crisp in a pan or air fryer.
recipes.notes: Recipe from Tim's newsletter. Nutrition per sandwich is an estimate.

recipes.title: Caramelized Sweet Potato Beef Bowls
steps: Heat the oven to 450°F with a large sheet pan inside.
Brush the sweet potato halves with 1 tbsp oil and 1 tsp salt and lay them cut side down on the hot pan. Roast about 45 minutes without flipping, until soft and caramelized underneath.
Meanwhile, heat the remaining oil in a skillet over medium-high. Cook the onion 3 minutes, add the beef and brown it, breaking it up.
Stir in the garlic, chili powder, pepper and remaining salt and cook 2 minutes, adding a splash of water if the spices stick.
Divide potatoes and beef into bowls. Pack cottage cheese and avocado separately so you can reheat the rest. Finish with hot honey or chili crisp.
recipes.notes: Recipe from Tim's newsletter. Nutrition per bowl is an estimate (without avocado or hot honey).

recipes.title: Sesame-Peanut Chicken Noodle Jars

items.i: boneless skinless chicken thighs or breasts

steps: Cook the glass noodles per the package. Drain, rinse well under cold water, drain again, and snip them shorter with scissors if you like.
Pat the chicken dry, season with salt and pepper and cook in the oil over medium-high, 5–7 minutes per side. Rest 5 minutes and slice (rotisserie chicken works too).
Whisk all the peanut sauce ingredients, adding warm water a spoonful at a time until pourable but still thick.
Divide the sauce among 4 large jars. Layer in order: cabbage, carrots, bell pepper, edamame, chicken, noodles, cucumber, scallions, cilantro.
Keep chilled up to 4 days. To eat, tip the jar into a bowl and toss well, adding a splash of water or lime if the sauce has thickened.
recipes.notes: Recipe from Tim's newsletter. Let the noodles and chicken cool fully before layering so the veg stays crisp. Nutrition per jar is an estimate.

recipes.title: Antipasto Pasta Salad

items.i: kosher salt, for the pasta water

steps: Boil the pasta in well-salted water until just past al dente so it stays tender cold. Save ½ cup pasta water, then drain.
Whisk the olive oil, vinegar, pepperoncini brine, Dijon, garlic, oregano, black pepper and red pepper flakes.
Toss the warm pasta with about two-thirds of the dressing and 2 tbsp pasta water. Cool 15 minutes.
Add the salami, provolone, tomatoes, olives, pepperoncini, onion and parsley and toss with the remaining dressing.
Taste for salt and acid, chill at least 30 minutes, and toss again before serving. Keeps 4 days.
recipes.notes: Recipe from Tim's newsletter. He adds leftover chicken from the noodle jars for extra protein. Nutrition per serving is an estimate.

recipes.title: Crispy, Airy Home-Oven Pizza Dough

items.i: cold water (about 30% as crushed ice if using a mixer)

steps: In the mixer bowl, combine the cold water (with crushed ice for about 30% of it, to keep the dough around 40°F), both flours, yeast and sugar. Mix on low about 10 minutes, scraping down as needed, aiming for a dough temperature around 62°F.
Cover and rest 30 minutes at room temperature.
Add the salt and mix 3 minutes on low.
Switch to medium and slowly add half the oil until mostly absorbed, then the rest. When the dough is no longer shiny, drop to low and mix until it reaches about 70°F.
Shape quickly, move to an oiled container and rest 30 minutes. With wet hands, stretch and fold all four sides. Rest 30 more minutes and repeat until it passes the windowpane test.
Refrigerate for 2 days (48–72 hours total fermentation).
Divide into 2 balls the night before or on baking day, and let them sit 3 hours at room temperature before stretching and baking.
recipes.notes: The video demonstrates the method; the gram amounts come from Dave's written go-to recipe (linked). Nutrition is an estimate for the dough only, per pizza, before toppings.

recipes.title: Spicy Tuna Crispy Rice

items.i: avocado, mashed with lime and salt

steps: Press chilled cooked rice into a flat, even slab and pan-fry it in a little oil until golden and crunchy on both sides.
Stir the tuna with the mayo, sriracha, sesame oil, lime juice, soy sauce and green onion.
Mash the avocado with a squeeze of lime and a pinch of salt.
Spread the avocado over the crispy rice, then top with the spicy tuna, more green onion and sesame seeds.
Cut into squares and serve right away while the rice is crunchy.
recipes.notes: The video is a 17-second clip in Spanish that names the ingredients but no amounts, so quantities, servings and nutrition are estimates.

recipes.title: 20-Minute Mackerel & Borlotti Bean Pasta

items.i: sea salt, for the pasta water
extra-virgin olive oil, plus more to finish
mackerel fillets in olive oil (about 120 g)
walnuts or pistachios, crushed, to serve

steps: Warm the olive oil in a large sauté pan over low–medium heat. Put a pot of well-salted water on to boil.
Add the crushed garlic, oregano and chili and cook gently without letting it sizzle hard. Add the olives and capers.
Season with pepper, add the chopped tomatoes and simmer.
Stir in the borlotti beans. Drop the pasta into the boiling water and cook 2 minutes less than the packet says.
Add the mackerel fillets and peas, folding gently so the fish stays in chunks.
Lift the pasta straight into the sauce with a spider so some pasta water comes with it, and stir gently.
Fold through the rocket, then serve topped with crushed nuts, a drizzle of olive oil and Parmesan if you like.
recipes.notes: Method from the video narration. The full written recipe is behind a sign-up link, so ingredient amounts, servings and nutrition are estimates. Swap the mackerel for white fish, prawns or leftover chicken.

recipes.title: Pistachio & Cacao Energy Balls

items.i: coconut oil, melted (or smooth nut butter)

steps: Cover the dates with boiling water for 10 minutes, then drain.
If rolling in pistachio crumb, blitz those 4 tbsp of pistachios fine first and set aside (saves washing the processor).
Pulse the pistachios to break them up, then add the dates, cacao, hemp seeds, coconut oil and tahini. Blitz until a ball of dough starts to form.
Roll tablespoons of dough into 12 balls, then roll each in the pistachio crumb.
Chill at least 1 hour. Keeps 5 days in the fridge or 3 months frozen.
recipes.notes: Recipe from the video description, which gives about 5 g protein and 3 g fiber per ball. Calories, carbs and fat are estimates.

recipes.title: One-Pan Creamy Tomato Pasta

items.i: grilled chicken, shrimp or Italian sausage (optional)

steps: Put the pasta nests, tomatoes, onion, spinach and garlic in a large skillet. Sprinkle over the dried herbs, chili, salt, pepper and lemon zest.
Spread the tomato paste over the top, drizzle with olive oil, then pour in the cream and broth.
Bring to a gentle simmer over medium heat, cover and cook 10 minutes, stirring now and then so the pasta separates and the paste melts into the sauce.
When the pasta is tender and the sauce has thickened, give it a final stir.
Top with basil, Parmesan and a protein if you like.
recipes.notes: Recipe from the video description. Nutrition is an estimate without any added protein.

recipes.title: Greek Yogurt Blueberry Pancakes

items.i: butter or oil, for the pan

steps: Whisk the Greek yogurt, milk, eggs, honey and vanilla until smooth.
Add the flour, baking powder and salt and whisk gently, just until combined. Don't overmix.
Cook scoops of batter on a lightly greased pan over medium heat, 3–4 minutes per side, until golden and cooked through.
Stack and serve with maple syrup and extra berries.
recipes.notes: Ingredients from the video description; method from the narration. The full recipe is on the linked page. Makes about 8 pancakes; servings and nutrition are estimates (without syrup).

recipes.title: Street Corn Chicken Bowls

items.i: lime juice and a pinch of salt

steps: Trim the chicken and toss with all the chicken seasonings, a squeeze of lime and the olive oil.
Rinse the rice, boil it then simmer on low until cooked. Let it cool, then mix in the cilantro, lime juice and a pinch of salt.
Spread the chicken on a large lined sheet pan. Bake 23 minutes at 200°C / 390°F, then broil 5–6 minutes until charred and juicy.
Take the chicken off the pan. Add the corn, red onion, garlic powder and paprika to the same pan, mix through the chicken juices, flatten, and roast 15 minutes until crispy.
Tip the roasted corn into a bowl with the bell pepper, jalapeño, yogurt, mayo, feta, cilantro and Tajín and mix until creamy.
Cube the chicken and divide into 6 containers with the rice and street corn salad.
recipes.notes: Recipe and macros per serving come from the video description.

recipes.title: Caramelized Onion Chicken Pasta

items.i: whole garlic bulb, top sliced off

steps: Toss the cubed chicken with its seasonings and olive oil and set aside.
In a large oven dish, mix the sliced onions, sun-dried tomatoes, seasonings and a spray of oil. Set the whole garlic bulb in the middle and cover with foil.
Bake 45 minutes at 190°C / 380°F, checking halfway, until golden and caramelized.

Squeeze in the roasted garlic and mix. While the dish is hot, add the parsley, soy sauce, Parmesan, evaporated milk and cream cheese and stir until melted and creamy (return to a low oven briefly to thicken if needed).
Fold in the cooked pasta until coated.
Spread the chicken on a lined sheet pan and bake 18 minutes at 200°C / 400°F, then broil 5 minutes until golden.
Divide the pasta and chicken into 6 portions.
recipes.notes: Recipe and macros per serving come from the video description. Cook the pasta while the onions roast.

recipes.title: Greek Yogurt Cream Cheese (Labneh)

items.i: olive oil, honey and a squeeze of lemon

steps: Stir the salt and lemon juice into the yogurt.
Line a sieve with paper towels or cheesecloth over a bowl, add the yogurt and cover with more paper. For an even thicker result, set something heavy on top.
Refrigerate overnight while the liquid drains out.
Next day it'll be thick like cream cheese. Flavor with chives or spring onion, or top with olive oil, honey and lemon and spread on a bagel.
recipes.notes: Method and amounts from the video narration (the description has no written recipe). Prep time doesn't include straining overnight. Nutrition per 2-tbsp-ish serving is an estimate.

recipes.title: Double Chocolate High-Protein Cheesecake
steps: Heat the oven to 325°F. Line a 9-inch springform pan with parchment and lightly spray the sides.
Blend the cream cheese, cottage cheese, eggs, sweetener, protein powder, cocoa and salt until completely smooth.
Microwave the frosting 10–15 seconds until pourable, drizzle over the batter and swirl with a knife.
Bake 45–50 minutes, until the edges are set but the center still jiggles slightly.
Turn off the oven, crack the door and leave it inside 15–20 minutes. Cool fully at room temperature.
Refrigerate at least 6 hours (overnight is best), then cut into 8 slices.
recipes.notes: Recipe from the video description; 278 calories and 20 g protein per slice as stated. Carbs and fat are estimates and depend on your protein powder and frosting. Time doesn't include chilling.

recipes.title: Salted Caramel "Twix" Bars

items.i: PB2 (powdered peanut butter), mixed with water

steps: Mix the almond flour, melted coconut oil, maple syrup and vanilla. Press firmly into a lined glass dish and freeze 10 minutes.
Mix the PB2 paste and cashew butter, then add the maple syrup, melted coconut oil and salt and stir until smooth.
Spread the caramel evenly over the base and freeze 1 hour.
Melt the chocolate and dip or pour it over each bar until coated.
Sprinkle with flaky salt and refrigerate 30 minutes to set.
recipes.notes: Recipe and macros per bar come from the video description (the creator's lighter version, using PB2 with the cashew butter). Active time only; add about 1½ hours of freezing and chilling.

recipes.title: Grilled Cheese Beef Burritos

items.i: large low-carb tortillas (e.g. Mission Carb Balance)
low-fat Greek yogurt or light sour cream

steps: Combine the rice, passata, tomato paste, beef broth, garlic and spices in a pot. Simmer covered on low 20–25 minutes, then fluff.
Brown the beef with the onion. Add the taco seasoning, chipotle paste, tomato paste and passata, then finish with cilantro and lime juice.
Warm the tortillas. Fill each with about 120 g rice and 150 g beef, plus nacho cheese, yogurt and sriracha mayo.
Sprinkle 25 g grated cheddar in a pan, place a burrito seam-side down on it and cook on low 2–4 minutes until the cheese crisps onto the tortilla.
Eat fresh, or cool, wrap in foil and refrigerate or freeze for meal prep.
recipes.notes: Recipe and macros per burrito come from the video description (the video has no narration). Brand suggestions are the creator's.

recipes.title: Creamy Chicken Alfredo Fried Rice
steps: Toss the cubed chicken with its seasonings and olive oil.
Boil the rice until cooked, drain and set aside.

Melt the butter over medium heat and cook the garlic and onion 5 minutes until soft. Add the salt and herbs and toast 2 minutes, then add the milk, Parmesan and cream cheese, stirring until smooth and creamy.
Spread the chicken on a lined sheet pan, spray with oil and bake 18 minutes at 200°C / 400°F, then broil 5 minutes until golden.
Lift out the chicken, leaving the juices. Add the red onion, sun-dried tomatoes, parsley and seasoning, mix through the juices, flatten and roast 15 minutes.
Fold the cooked rice into the pan until colored and fluffy.
Serve the rice with the chicken and a pour of Alfredo sauce.
recipes.notes: Recipe and macros per serving come from the video description.

recipes.title: Peri Peri Chicken Cucumber Salad
steps: Cook the peri peri chicken until golden and cooked through, then let it cool slightly.
Slice the cucumber and onion into a bowl or lidded container.
Mix the yogurt, garlic, lemon juice, oil, salt and pepper.
Add the chicken and dressing, put the lid on and shake (or toss) until everything is coated.
recipes.notes: Recipe and macros for the whole bowl come from the video description. Swap in any protein you like.

recipes.title: Ground Beef, Sweet Potato & Rice Lunch Bowl

items.i: salt, pepper and your favorite sauce
sauerkraut or beet kraut, on the side (optional)

steps: Roast the sweet potato cubes at 425°F for 25–30 minutes until caramelized.
Brown the ground meat, drain off the fat and season.
Steam or sauté the broccoli or carrots.
Pile the meat, sweet potato, rice and veg into a bowl, add sauce and a side of kraut.
recipes.notes: A meal template from the video rather than a precise recipe: he names 8 oz of meat with a starch and veg. Other amounts and the nutrition are estimates. Batch-cook for the week.

recipes.title: Steak, Sweet Potato & Rice Dinner Bowl
steps: Roast the sweet potato cubes at 425°F for 25–30 minutes.
Season the steak and sear or grill to your liking. Rest 5 minutes, then slice.
Serve the steak over rice with the sweet potato and broccoli, plus hot sauce and kraut.
recipes.notes: A meal template from the video: 8–10 oz steak with potatoes or rice, veg and something cultured. Other amounts and nutrition are estimates.

recipes.title: Protein Yogurt Dessert Bowl
steps: Stir the protein powder and PB2 into the yogurt until thick and smooth (add a splash of milk if it's too stiff).
Fold in the frozen berries and let them sit a minute so they bleed into the yogurt.
recipes.notes: From the video's list of go-to meals: plain Greek yogurt with protein powder, PB2 and frozen berries. Amounts and nutrition are estimates.

recipes.title: Chocolate Peanut Butter Banana Bark

items.i: crushed mixed nuts or salted peanuts

steps: Lay the bananas on baking paper and press them flat into an even layer (a second tray on top makes it easy).
Spread the peanut butter over the banana.
Spread or drizzle the melted dark chocolate over the top and sprinkle with the nuts.
Freeze a couple of hours until completely set.
Cut or break into 10 pieces and keep them in the freezer.
recipes.notes: Recipe and macros per piece come from the video description. Freezing time not included.

recipes.title: Cottage Cheese Brownie Balls
steps: Blend the cottage cheese, peanut butter, maple syrup and vanilla until smooth.
Add the almond flour and cocoa powder and mix until you get a thick brownie dough.
Roll into 8 balls and freeze for 5–10 minutes while you melt the chocolate.
Melt the chocolate with the coconut oil until silky, coat each ball and sprinkle with a little sea salt.
Refrigerate about 30 minutes until the shell is fully set and crunchy.
recipes.notes: Recipe and macros per ball come from the video description (original recipe by @nora.dora99). Chilling time not included.

recipes.title: Fudge Brownie Cheesecake Bars
steps: Mix the oat flour, cocoa, maple syrup, coconut oil, almond milk and vanilla. Press into a lined tin and freeze 10 minutes.
Beat the cream cheese, sweetener, vanilla and lemon juice with a hand mixer until smooth. Spread over the base and freeze 45 minutes.
Mix the cocoa, maple syrup, coconut oil and almond milk into a thick fudgy sauce and spread it over the top.
Refrigerate at least 30 minutes, then cut into 6 bars.
recipes.notes: Recipe and per-bar macros come from the video description (original recipe by @nora.dora99). Gluten-free only if you use certified GF oat flour. Freezing and chilling time (about 1½ hours) not included.

recipes.title: Carne con Chile y Papas

items.i: thin-sliced lean beef (sirloin or milanesa), cut in strips

steps: In a lightly oiled pan, blister the tomatoes, chiles, onion and garlic until charred in spots.
Blend the charred vegetables with the water and bouillon until smooth.
Season the beef strips and brown them in the pan with just a little oil, then add the sliced onion.
Pour the chile sauce over the beef, add the diced potatoes and simmer, covered, until the potatoes are tender and the sauce thickens (about 20 minutes).
Serve with Mexican rice and warm tortillas.
recipes.notes: The video doesn't give amounts — quantities and macros (per serving, without rice or tortillas) are estimates from what's shown. Use little oil, as she suggests, to keep it light.

recipes.title: Strawberry Honey Gummy Bears

items.i: strawberries, washed and hulled (or watermelon, green apple)
agar agar powder (1 tbsp per cup of purée)

steps: Blend the strawberries, lemon juice, honey and elderberry syrup until completely smooth.
Pour into a pot and whisk in 1 tbsp agar powder for every cup of purée. Cook on medium-high, stirring constantly, for 2 minutes until there are no clumps.
Turn the heat down and keep stirring for another 2 minutes. Take off the heat and keep stirring as it cools slightly so it doesn't set in the pot.
Use a dropper or syringe to fill gummy molds.
Refrigerate at least 4 hours (overnight is best), then pop them out.
recipes.notes: Amounts are from the video; agar quantity assumes about 3 cups of purée. Macros are estimates for 1/8 of the batch. Setting time not included. Not suitable for babies under 1 because of the honey — use maple syrup instead. Plant-based only with maple syrup.

recipes.title: Flourless Blueberry Peanut Butter Muffins
steps: Mash the bananas, then mix in the peanut butter, eggs and baking powder until smooth. Fold in the blueberries.
Let cool for 10 minutes before eating.
recipes.notes: Recipe and per-muffin macros come from the video description (original by @lukezfit; he used 50 g less peanut butter than the original).

recipes.title: Dairy-Free 100-Calorie Fudgy Brownies
steps: Stir the applesauce, nut butter, cocoa powder, sweetener, vanilla and salt together until smooth and glossy.
Spread into a parchment-lined 8×8 in (20 cm) pan and bake at 350 °F (175 °C) for about 25 minutes, until set at the edges but still a little wobbly in the middle.
Let cool completely so they firm up and turn fudgy, then cut into 9 squares.
recipes.notes: The video names the ingredients but not the amounts — quantities, bake time and macros (other than her stated ~100 cal per brownie) are estimates. No flour, no dairy, no cottage cheese.

recipes.title: One-Dish Creamy BBQ Chicken Pasta Bake

items.i: cooked chicken breast, diced (about 600 g raw)

steps: Add everything except the mozzarella — uncooked pasta included — to a large baking dish and mix until fully combined.
Top with the mozzarella and cover tightly with foil.
Bake 30 minutes covered, then uncover and bake 20 minutes more until the pasta is tender and the cheese is golden.
Rest 10 minutes so the sauce thickens, then divide into 4.
recipes.notes: Recipe and per-serving macros come from the video description (original by @davefellfitness). Using pre-cooked chicken makes it faster.

recipes.title: Creamy Garlic Prawn Pasta

items.i: chilli flakes (optional), plus extra to serve
Parmigiano Reggiano, freshly grated, plus extra to serve

steps: Cook the pasta in well-salted boiling water until just shy of al dente; save a cup of pasta water.
Season the prawns and sear in the olive oil and half the butter over high heat for about a minute per side until just cooked. Remove to a plate.
Lower the heat, add the remaining butter, garlic and chilli flakes and cook until fragrant. Add the stock and reduce by half, then stir in the cream.
Add the pasta, Parmesan, lemon zest and juice, and a splash of pasta water; toss until glossy and coating the pasta. Return the prawns and season.
Finish with parsley, extra Parmesan and chilli flakes.
recipes.notes: Ingredients come from the video description; the full method is on Chef Jack's site (linked). Macros per serving are estimates.

recipes.title: Chocolate Orange Cottage Cheese Pots

items.i: liquid monk fruit sweetener, to taste
splash of water, if needed to blend

steps: Blend the cottage cheese, cocoa, vanilla, sweetener, salt and orange zest until completely smooth and creamy, adding a splash of water only if it won't blend.
Pour into two small ramekins or cups.
Pour the melted chocolate over the top and spread it into an even layer.
Refrigerate at least 10 minutes, until the chocolate sets into a crackable shell.
recipes.notes: The video doesn't give amounts — quantities and macros (per pot) are estimates from what's shown.

recipes.title: Stuffed Cottage Cheese Wrap
steps: Blend the cottage cheese, eggs, salt, garlic powder and Parmesan until just smooth — not runny.
Pour onto a parchment-lined tray from the centre outward and gently spread into a large flatbread shape. Don't go too thin or it will tear.
Bake at 350 °F (175 °C) for 25–30 minutes until golden and set.
Let it cool about 5 minutes before peeling it off the parchment.
Line the filling along one end, roll it up tightly and cut in half.
recipes.notes: She uses 225 g cottage cheese and 2 eggs. Stefan Bodegrajac's remake of this video (youtube.com/watch?v=gndBpViJE70) gives the wrap alone as 310 cal, 37 g protein, 10 g carbs, 12 g fat. Filling amounts and the per-half macros with her filling are estimates. Make sure the top is golden or the inside stays too soft. Stuff it with anything — meat is optional since most of the protein is in the wrap.

recipes.title: Fudgy Butternut Squash Brownies

items.i: butternut squash, roasted and peeled (about 1 small squash)
powdered sweetener (monk fruit or stevia blend)

steps: Halve the squash, scoop out the seeds and roast cut-side down at 200 °C (400 °F) for about 35 minutes until soft. Cool and peel.
Blend the squash, egg whites, cocoa, oat flour, sweetener, vanilla, baking powder and salt until smooth.
Stir in the chocolate chips and pour into a lined loaf tin or small tray.
Bake at 180 °C (350 °F) for 35–40 minutes, until just a little jiggly in the centre.
Let cool fully, then chill — they're best cold from the fridge. Cut into 5 slices.
recipes.notes: Recipe and per-slice macros come from the video description (original recipe by @madelainerascan). Total time includes roasting the squash. Great cold on top of Greek yogurt.

recipes.title: Tiramisu Protein Chia Pudding
steps: Stir the chia seeds, yogurt, protein powder, maple syrup, milk and espresso together until smooth. Scale up to make several jars at once.
Divide into jars and refrigerate overnight.
Dust the top with cocoa powder before eating.
recipes.notes: Recipe and per-jar macros come from the video description (original by @balancewithnu). Overnight chilling not included in the time.

recipes.title: High Protein Greek Yogurt Bagels

items.i: everything bagel seasoning or sesame seeds

steps: Mix the flour, Greek yogurt, baking powder, salt and garlic powder until it comes together, then knead by hand into a dough ball.
Cut into 4 even pieces and shape each into a bagel. Lightly flour your hands if the dough is sticky.
Brush with egg wash and sprinkle generously with everything bagel seasoning.
Bake at 190 °C (375 °F) for 25–30 minutes until golden brown.
recipes.notes: Recipe, calories and protein per bagel come from the video description. Carbs and fat are estimates.

recipes.title: Lemon Cottage Cheese Cheesecake Cup

items.i: sweetener, to taste (optional — e.g. monk fruit drops)

steps: Blend the cottage cheese, lemon zest, lemon juice, vanilla, salt and sweetener until completely smooth.
Pour into a bowl or glass.
Crush the graham crackers in a bag and scatter over the top.
Eat straight away, or chill for a thicker texture.
recipes.notes: Recipe and macros (per serve) come from the video description (original recipe by @madelainerascan). The description says zest of a lemon; the video uses half.

recipes.title: Chicken-Crust Spinach & Cheese Calzone
steps: Spread the ground chicken thinly over a parchment-lined tray with a fork or spoon. Season with salt, pepper, onion powder, garlic powder and Italian seasoning.
Blend the cottage cheese until smooth.
Sauté the garlic in the oil, add the spinach and wilt. Stir in the blended cottage cheese, a squeeze of lemon and salt.
Spread the filling over one half of the chicken base, then use the parchment to fold the other half over.
Top with Parmesan and bake at 200 °C (400 °F) for 20–30 minutes, until golden and 74 °C (165 °F) inside. Oven or air fryer both work.
Warm the tomato sauce for dipping.
recipes.notes: Recipe and whole-calzone macros come from the video description (original by @madelainerascan).

recipes.title: Chocolate Chip Cloud Bread

items.i: low-sugar chocolate chips (¼–⅓ cup), plus extra for the top

steps: Whip the egg whites in a large bowl to medium peaks.
Add the monk fruit and lemon juice (and cornstarch, if using) and keep whipping to stiff peaks — this part is critical.
Gently fold in the chocolate chips.
Spread onto a parchment-lined tray or dish and shape into a little loaf with a spatula. Top with more chips if you like.
Bake at 160 °C (315 °F) for 35–40 minutes until golden on top. Rest a couple of minutes, then rip it open.
recipes.notes: Recipe comes from the video description, which says the whole loaf is under 150 calories depending on your chocolate chips. Protein, carbs and fat are estimates (without cornstarch). Low carb unless you add the cornstarch.

recipes.title: Lemon Chicken & Rice Power Skillet

items.i: bag Kaizen high-protein rice (or 4 servings rice of choice)
parsley, finely chopped, plus extra to serve

steps: Toss the chicken with 1 tsp olive oil, salt, pepper, onion powder, oregano, paprika, lemon zest and juice, and garlic. Marinate 1–6 hours if you can, or cook straight away.
Heat the oven to 200 °C (400 °F). Heat 1 tsp olive oil in an ovenproof skillet over medium heat and cook the chicken skin-side down for 8 minutes, flip and cook 8 more. Set aside.
Add the bone broth and diced onion to the same skillet and simmer 4–5 minutes, scraping up the browned bits.
Cook the rice according to the package, stir it into the skillet and nestle the chicken on top.
Bake 15–20 minutes until the chicken is cooked through.
Toss the sliced onion with the lemon juice, salt and parsley. Rest 5 minutes and toss again.
Mix the yogurt with the olive oil, lemon juice, mint, parsley, garlic, salt and pepper.
Top the skillet with dollops of yogurt spread, the pickled onions and fresh parsley.
recipes.notes: Recipe, calories and protein per serving come from the video description; macros assume the chicken skin is removed and high-protein Kaizen rice (regular rice will raise the carbs). Carbs and fat are estimates. Marinating time not included.

recipes.title: 6-Ingredient Healthy Twix Bars
steps: Heat the oven to 175 °C (350 °F) and line a 9×9-inch pan with parchment. Mix the shortbread ingredients, press evenly into the pan and bake about 10 minutes until the edges are lightly golden. Cool at least 10 minutes.
Whisk the caramel ingredients in a small saucepan over medium-low heat until gently bubbling, about 2 minutes. Pour over the cooled crust and spread.
Melt the chocolate chips with the coconut oil until smooth, spread over the caramel and sprinkle with flaky salt. Refrigerate about 30 minutes until hardened.
Lift out and cut into 16 bars (or 32 minis).
recipes.notes: Amounts, method and per-bar macros come from Sam's written recipe (linked). Total time includes chilling.

recipes.title: Grilled Cheese Breakfast Burritos

items.i: low-fat grated cheese (25 g per burrito, inside)
low-fat grated cheddar (20 g per burrito, for the crust)

steps: Sear the ground beef for 5 minutes, then add the onion and break it up as it cooks.
Add the taco seasoning and tomato paste and mix well, then stir in the refried beans. Set aside.
Whisk the eggs with the egg whites. Melt the butter in a pan over medium heat and scramble until light and fluffy. Season with salt and pepper.
Mix all the chipotle sauce ingredients until smooth.
On each tortilla, add a dollop of sauce, ⅙ of the beef mix, ⅙ of the eggs and 25 g cheese. Roll up tightly.
Sprinkle 20 g cheddar into a pan over medium heat. When it bubbles, place the burrito on it folded-side down; once the cheese crisps, wrap it around the burrito. Repeat for all 6.
recipes.notes: Amounts are from the on-screen text; calories and protein per burrito are from the video title. Carbs and fat are estimates, and the cheese totals assume 6 burritos. The refried beans are optional.

recipes.title: Low-Calorie Glazed Donuts (Protein Glaze Option)

items.i: sugar (5 g of it goes into the milk)
almond milk or water, a little at a time
almond milk, a little at a time

steps: Microwave the milk 30–45 seconds until lukewarm (warm, not hot). Stir in the yeast and about 5 g of the sugar and rest 5 minutes.
Melt the butter, add the vanilla, let it cool slightly, then whisk in the egg. Mix in the yeasty milk.
In a large bowl mix the flour, remaining sugar, pumpkin pie spice and salt. Pour in the wet mix and stir into a dough.
Knead in the bowl — stretch, fold and press — for 4–5 minutes until smooth, soft and less sticky.
Place in an oiled bowl, cover with a towel and leave somewhere warm (an oven with just the light on) for 1–2 hours until doubled.
Punch down, roll to about ½ inch thick and cut 3-inch circles with a 1-inch hole. Re-roll the scraps. Makes about 15.
Rest the donuts on parchment in the warm (off) oven for 20 minutes.
Blend the erythritol to a powder. For either glaze, add almond milk a few drops at a time until thick but runny.
Spray with oil and air fry at 175 °C (350 °F) for 3 minutes. Cook just what you'll eat — keep the rest of the cut dough wrapped in the fridge for up to a week.
Dip the warm donuts in glaze and set on a wire rack 1–2 minutes until the glaze hardens.
recipes.notes: Recipe and macros come from the video description. Macros shown are with the protein glaze; with the zero-calorie glaze it's 104 cal, 2 g protein, 17 g carbs, 2 g fat per donut. Total time includes rising.

recipes.title: Crispy Honey Garlic Chicken Tenders

items.i: chicken breasts, each sliced into 3 strips

steps: Mix the flour with the salt, onion powder, garlic powder, paprika and pepper on a plate.
Slice each chicken breast into 3 strips and coat all sides in the seasoned flour.
Beat the egg with the pickle juice on a second plate and dunk each strip until fully coated.
Press the strips firmly into the cornflakes on a third plate for an even coating.
Spray lightly with oil, then oven bake at 190 °C for 20–25 minutes or air fry at 180 °C for 12–15 minutes.
Melt the butter in a pan on low heat, add the soy sauce, honey, garlic paste and chilli flakes. Bring to a bubble and simmer until thickened.
Roll the crispy tenders in the sauce until fully coated.
recipes.notes: Amounts and cook settings come from the on-screen text; calories and protein per tender from the video. The on-screen fractions for the spices, pickle juice and chilli didn't display, so those are estimated as ½, and the number of chicken breasts is estimated. Carbs and fat are estimates.

recipes.title: Barely-Any-Calorie Pre-Dinner Snacks

items.i: red wine vinegar (or balsamic / apple cider)
quick spray of avocado or olive oil

steps: Dip carrot sticks in hot mustard.
Keep dill pickle spears in the fridge for a quick salty hit.
Chop the cucumber into a bowl, add a splash of vinegar, salt and pepper, tear in some basil and dust with a teaspoon of nutritional yeast.
Spread the broccolini on a lined tray, give it a quick spray of oil, salt it and sprinkle with nutritional yeast. Roast at about 220 °C (425 °F) for 12–15 minutes until crispy at the tips.
recipes.notes: Four low-calorie snacks to take the edge off before dinner. The video doesn't give amounts, oven settings or macros — those are estimates (macros per serving of the cucumber bowl plus half the broccolini). Go easy on the oil.

recipes.title: Blue Zone Mediterranean Bread Dip
steps: Pour the olive oil into a shallow bowl.
Grate the tomatoes straight in, skins left behind.
Add the chopped shallot, olives and feta, then season with salt, pepper, oregano and parsley. Add the red wine vinegar and mix well.
Drizzle with balsamic glaze and scatter over the pomegranate seeds.
recipes.notes: Amounts are as said in the video (handfuls are to taste). Macros per serving are estimates for the dip only — bread not included.

recipes.title: High-Protein Big Mac Burger

items.i: 96/4 lean ground beef, as 2 thin patties

steps: Mix the yogurt, mayo, ketchup, mustard, pickle juice, paprika, apple cider vinegar and relish until smooth. Keep it in a squeeze bottle.
Season the beef and smash into 2 thin patties. Cook on high heat for about 1 minute per side.
Toast the brioche bun, add the patties with the Swiss cheese and a good squeeze of sauce.
recipes.notes: Amounts are from the on-screen text. On screen: the burger is 482 cal and 46 g protein; a serving of sauce has 4 g protein;the beef is 200 cal and 30 g protein; the bun is 160 cal and 6 g protein; the Swiss is 80 cal and 6 g protein. The sauce recipe makes more than one serving. Carbs and fat are estimates.

recipes.title: Cottage Cheese Cloud Bread

items.i: a few berries, to dot on top (optional)

steps: Blend the cottage cheese with the 3 egg yolks until smooth.
Whip the egg whites with the lemon juice, the ¼ tsp addition and the cornstarch to stiff peaks.
Fold half the yolk mixture into the whites, then gently fold in the rest.
Pile onto a parchment-lined tray and shape into a dome. Dot with berries if you like.
recipes.notes: Amounts are as said in the video; the whole loaf is 290 cal and 27 g protein per the on-screen text. The ¼ tsp ingredient isn't clear from the audio, and carbs and fat are estimates.

recipes.title: California Roll Cucumber Salad
steps: Thinly slice the whole cucumber (a mandoline helps) into a large lidded container.
Add the prawns or crab, cream cheese, Kewpie, avocado, soy sauce, sesame seeds and MSG.
Put the lid on and shake really well until everything is coated.
recipes.notes: Recipe and whole-bowl macros come from the video description. Tastes like a California roll in a bowl.

recipes.title: Cottage Cheese Blueberry Muffins
steps: Mix the cottage cheese, eggs, almond flour, sweetener and baking powder.
Gently fold in the blueberries at the end so they don't mash.
Divide between 6 lined muffin cups and bake at 180 °C (350 °F) for 20–25 minutes until golden and set.
recipes.notes: Recipe and per-muffin macros come from the video description (original by @ketosnackz). Good to prep ahead. Low carb with almond flour; other flours will raise the carbs.

recipes.title: 3-Ingredient Peanut Butter Chocolate Bites

items.i: unsweetened apple purée / applesauce (about ½ cup)

steps: Mix the powdered peanut butter and applesauce into a dough.
Dip each ball in the melted chocolate with a fork and set on parchment.
Refrigerate about 10 minutes until the chocolate sets.
recipes.notes: Recipe and per-bite macros come from the video description (makes 12; the original by @healthyu_dietitian makes 16 smaller ones). Tastes like Reese's balls. Check your chocolate if you need it vegan.

recipes.title: High-Protein Cottage Cheese Tiramisu
steps: Blend the cottage cheese on its own until there are no lumps at all.
Add the Greek yogurt and blend, then add the pudding mix, salt and protein powder and blend until thick and smooth. Chill 10–15 minutes.
Quickly dip each ladyfinger in the coffee — don't soak — and line an 8×8-inch dish.
Spread half the cream on top in an even layer and dust lightly with cinnamon.
Repeat with another layer of dipped ladyfingers and the rest of the cream.
Dust with cocoa, cover and refrigerate overnight. Cut into 9 squares.
recipes.notes: Recipe and macros come from the video description (whole dish 1,298 cal, 111 g protein). He warns fat-free cottage cheese tastes off — use 2% or 4%. Overnight chill not included in the time.

recipes.title: High-Protein Smash Burger Tacos

items.i: chopped red onion or pickled onions

steps: Press the beef into a thin, even layer right onto the tortilla. Season generously with salt, pepper and garlic powder.
Place beef-side down in a hot pan over medium-high heat and cook until crispy.
While it cooks, mix all the sauce ingredients until smooth.
Flip, add the mozzarella and cover until melted.
Top with onion, lettuce and sauce, then fold like a taco.
recipes.notes: Recipe and per-taco macros come from the video description (original by @hunt4shredz). The sauce makes extra for more tacos.

recipes.title: Avocado Chocolate Mousse
steps: Blend the avocado, banana, cocoa, honey and vanilla until completely smooth.
Spoon into a jar and top with the frozen blueberries.
recipes.notes: Recipe and macros come from the video description (original by @james_white_training). Adjust the amounts to fit your macros. You can't taste the avocado. Note the description says 20 ml vanilla — use less if you prefer.

recipes.title: Chicken Shawarma Rice Bowls
steps: Toss the chicken with the garlic, spices, olive oil and lemon juice until well coated.
Lay on a sheet pan and bake or air fry at 200 °C (400 °F) for 20 minutes, then broil 3–4 minutes to char. Rest 4–5 minutes, chop into cubes and toss in the pan juices.
Melt the butter and cook the garlic and onion over medium-low for 5–6 minutes until soft. Add the turmeric, paprika, salt and rice and toast 2–3 minutes.
Add the water, bring to a light bubble, cover and simmer 10–12 minutes until cooked, stirring once halfway.
Mix the yogurt, mayo, honey, salt, pepper and garlic powder, then add pickle juice to the consistency you like.
Toss the onion, tomatoes, gherkins and parsley with the salt, pepper and sumac.
Divide the rice and chicken between 5 containers and top with slaw and garlic sauce.
recipes.notes: Recipe and per-bowl macros come from the video description. In the video he also adds a little tomato paste to the chicken marinade. Store the sauce and slaw separately for meal prep.

recipes.title: Crispy Garlic Parmesan Chicken Tenders & Potatoes

items.i: raw chicken breast (500–600 g), cut into strips

steps: Slice the chicken into medium strips and toss with the salt, paprika, oregano, garlic powder, onion powder and olive oil.
Whisk the egg. Dip each strip in egg, let the excess drip off, then press firmly into the crushed cornflakes.
Lay on a lined tray and air fry or bake at 185 °C (375 °F) for 15–18 minutes until golden and crispy.
Toss the cubed potatoes with the same spices and oil, then air fry at 200 °C for 25 minutes until crispy.
Whisk the sauce ingredients. Top the tenders with Parmesan and parsley and serve with the potatoes and sauce.
recipes.notes: Recipe and per-tender macros come from the video description (macros are for the tenders; potatoes and sauce are extra).

recipes.title: Chocolate Banana Cottage Cheese Cake
steps: Mash the bananas, then mix in the eggs, cottage cheese, cocoa, maple syrup and baking powder until combined.
Pour into a lined loaf tin and bake at 200 °C for about 50 minutes (ovens vary).
Let it cool at least 20 minutes — it's very moist inside. Dust with icing sugar and cut into 8 slices.
recipes.notes: Recipe and per-slice macros come from the video description (original by @fillingmeals). Tips: use very ripe bananas, add stevia for more sweetness, or top with sugar-free chocolate chips. Gluten-free as made (check your baking powder).

recipes.title: Sheet-Pan Crispy Cheesy Beef Tacos

items.i: red and green bell pepper, chopped
each salt, paprika, oregano, garlic powder, onion powder and cumin

steps: Mix all the sauce ingredients until smooth and chill.
Spread the onion and peppers on a large lined sheet pan, spray with oil, season and roast 15 minutes at 180 °C (370 °F).
Spread the beef over the veg with the beef seasonings, tomato paste and coriander. Mix by hand, flatten, score lightly and spray.
Bake 6 minutes to partially cook, break it up, then return for another 5–6 minutes until lightly crisp. Add a splash of water and stir until juicy. Remove the beef.
Dip each tortilla in the pan juices, fill with mozzarella and beef and fold tightly.
Bake the tacos on the tray 12 minutes, flipping halfway, until golden and crispy. Serve with the sauce.
recipes.notes: Recipe and per-taco macros come from the video description, which says it makes 15+ tacos. Great for meal prep.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Protein Banana Bread
steps: Mash the banana, then mix in the milk, flour, PB2, vanilla, protein powder, baking powder, eggs and salt to a batter.
Pour into a lined loaf dish and top with the banana slices (and chocolate chips, if using).
Let it sit at least 20 minutes before cutting into 8 slices.
recipes.notes: Recipe and per-slice macros come from the video description (original by @hunt4shredz, which also adds up to ½ cup zero-calorie sweetener).

recipes.title: High-Protein Chocolate Lava Cake
steps: Process the cottage cheese until smooth and add it to an oven-safe dish.
Crack in the eggs and add the cacao, sweetener and vanilla. Mix well.
Scatter chocolate chips over the top, if using.
Bake at 180 °C (350 °F) for 30 minutes. Cool slightly, then dig in.
recipes.notes: Recipe and whole-dish macros come from the video description (original by @shredhappens).

recipes.title: Giant Protein Cloud Bread

items.i: vanilla (or white chocolate) flavour drops / sweetener
protein powder — chocolate in the original, strawberry in his

steps: Whip the egg whites and sweetener with an electric mixer for about 8 minutes until thick, glossy and fluffy.
Gently fold through the protein powder.
Pour into a lined baking dish and bake at 180 °C for 15 minutes — it puffs up dramatically.
recipes.notes: Recipe and whole-recipe macros come from the video description (original chocolate version by @supercoach_melissa). An electric mixer is essential. Texture lands between a soufflé, cake and cloud bread.

recipes.title: Lemon Chicken & Mushroom Protein Pasta

items.i: chicken thigh fillets, blitzed into mince
Parmesan, freshly grated, plus extra to serve

steps: Heat the oil in a pan over medium-high until just smoking. Spread the chicken mince out, season, and leave it 3–4 minutes to brown, then break it up and cook about 5 minutes total. Remove.
In the same pan, add the mushrooms with a pinch of salt and don't touch them for 3–4 minutes so they brown.
Add the onion and cook 3–4 minutes until soft, then the garlic for 1 minute.
Return the chicken and juices, add the stock pots and stock, bring to a simmer and reduce by half, 5–6 minutes, until glossy.
Meanwhile boil the spaghetti in salted water for 2 minutes less than the packet says. Save a cup of pasta water and drain.
Toss the pasta in the sauce, then take it off the heat. Stir in the Parmesan, lemon zest and juice and two-thirds of the chives, then loosen with pasta water to the consistency you like.
Divide into 5 containers and finish with extra Parmesan, pepper and the rest of the chives.
recipes.notes: Ingredients come from the video description and per-serve macros from the on-screen card; the full method is on Chef Jack's site (linked). No cream — the sauce is a Parmesan and pasta-water emulsion. Chicken thigh mince keeps it juicy.

recipes.title: Iceberg Lettuce Wraps (4 Fillings)

items.i: slaw, tomato and a creamy sauce
pickled jalapeños and a spicy mayo

steps: Lay a sheet of parchment on the board and stack several large iceberg leaves into a bowl shape.
Pile your filling into the centre — pick one of the four combos or use leftovers.
Use the parchment to roll it up tightly like a burrito, tucking in the sides.
Slice through the parchment and serve in halves.
recipes.notes: The video is a montage of lettuce-wrap fillings with no amounts or macros. Fillings are identified from what's shown; amounts and macros (for the taco-beef version) are estimates. The parchment roll is what keeps it together.

recipes.title: High-Protein Cottage Cheese Mac & Cheese

items.i: boneless skinless chicken breast, cooked (24 oz)

steps: Boil the macaroni in salted water per the package. Save about 1 cup pasta water before draining.
Blend the cottage cheese until completely smooth, adding a splash of water if it's too thick.
Warm the blended cottage cheese in a saucepan over medium-low, adding pasta water gradually to the consistency you like.
Stir in the cheddar, garlic powder, MSG and salt until melted and smooth. Bring to a light simmer.
Add the pasta and toss until coated. Top with sliced chicken if you like.
recipes.notes: Recipe and macros come from the video description (recipe credit: Joshua Weissman). With the chicken it's 542 cal, 60 g protein, 48 g carbs, 10 g fat per serving. Joshua Weissman's original video is also in your playlist: youtube.com/watch?v=zKB-sEgAVaw.

recipes.title: Glazed High-Protein Blueberry Muffin Loaf
steps: Preheat to 175 °C (350 °F) and line a loaf pan with parchment.
Whisk all the dry ingredients together.
In another bowl mix the egg, egg whites, syrup, melted butter, vanilla and yogurt.
Add the dry to the wet in 3 batches, mixing gently and stopping as soon as the flour disappears.
Fold in the blueberries, pour into the pan and level it out to the corners.
Bake 40–45 minutes, turning halfway, until a toothpick comes out clean. Cool 10 minutes in the pan, then fully on a rack.
Mix the frosting and spread over the top. Cut into 7 slices; keeps up to 7 days in an airtight container in the fridge.
recipes.notes: Recipe and per-slice macros come from the video description (whole loaf: 1,441 cal, 119 g protein). He uses 12 g of inulin in the video. Storage tip from the video: keep slices on paper towel in an airtight container so they don't dry out or go soggy.

recipes.title: High-Protein High-Fiber Chicken Bowl with Zucchini Egg Noodles

items.i: dry garlic, paprika, salt and pepper
garlic, salt, pepper and lemon juice

steps: Toss the chicken with half the oil, dry garlic, paprika, salt and pepper.
Fry until golden brown, then add the onion and cook 1–2 minutes together until caramelized. Stir in the parsley.
Mix the grated zucchini into the beaten egg with a pinch of salt. Cook in the remaining oil as a thin pancake (or a few small ones so they're easy to flip), turning carefully.
Roll or stack the pancake and slice into noodle-like strips.
Fill a bowl with the lettuce, radish, cucumber, chickpeas, zucchini egg noodles and chicken.
Mix the yogurt with garlic, salt, pepper and lemon juice and spoon over the top.
recipes.notes: Recipe and macros (about 500 cal, 66 g protein, 9 g fiber) come from the video description.

recipes.title: Sheet-Pan Crispy Garlic Parmesan Chicken Wraps

items.i: dried parsley, plus fresh to finish
grated Parmesan, plus extra to finish
shredded lettuce, chopped tomato and onion

steps: Toss the cubed chicken with the seasonings, Parmesan and olive oil until well coated.
Melt the butter over low heat with the herbs, garlic powder and paprika for a minute, then stir in the evaporated milk, Parmesan and cream cheese until smooth and creamy.
Spread the chicken on a parchment-lined sheet pan without crowding, spray lightly and bake at 200 °C for 20–22 minutes until crispy.
While hot, toss with extra Parmesan and fresh parsley.
Fill each wrap with lettuce, onion, tomato, chicken and sauce.
recipes.notes: Recipe and per-wrap macros come from the video description. The description lists a second 100 g of Parmesan in the sauce, but the video adds light cream cheese — I've used cream cheese. Store chicken and sauce separately; reheat the chicken 4–5 minutes at 180 °C.

recipes.title: 5-Minute Mortadella Breakfast Sandwich
steps: Whisk the eggs, mayo and salt until smooth.
Pour into a lightly greased microwave-safe bowl and microwave 45–60 seconds until just set (José Andrés' trick).
Meanwhile sear the mortadella in a non-stick pan over medium-high for 1 minute, flip, top with the cheese and cook 1 minute more.
Toast the cut bun in the mortadella fat for 30–45 seconds.
Stack the bun, cheesy mortadella and the egg 'omelette', then top.
recipes.notes: Amounts are as said in the video; the mortadella count is an estimate and the macros are estimates (not a light recipe).

recipes.title: High-Protein Chocolate Date Chia Mousse
steps: Blend everything except the chia seeds until smooth.
Pour into jars and stir the chia seeds through each.
Cover and refrigerate at least 2 hours until thick like mousse.
Top with berries, coconut or dark chocolate.
recipes.notes: Recipe and macros come from the video description. The description calls it 1 serving, but in the video it fills 3 pots and he says each pot is about 400 cal, 30 g protein and nearly 15 g fiber — so macros are per pot. Chilling time not included.

recipes.title: Cauliflower Protein Chicken Alfredo
steps: Boil the cauliflower until very soft — overcooking it makes the creamiest sauce.
Blend the cauliflower with the Parmesan, Pecorino, garlic, skim milk, salt and pepper until silky.
Season and sear the chicken in a hot pan until golden and cooked through. Rest and slice.
Cook the fettuccine, then toss it in a pan with the sauce until coated.
Top with the sliced chicken and extra grated cheese.
recipes.notes: Sauce amounts are from the video; per-serving macros are from the on-screen card. The cauliflower, pasta and chicken amounts and the 2 servings are estimates.

recipes.title: High-Protein Nacho Cheese Beef Burritos
steps: Press the beef into a hot pan and leave it to get crispy, then flip and break it up.
Add the onion, peppers and taco seasoning and cook until soft.
Stir in the ketchup and water until the beef is coated.
In a saucepan over low heat, stir the evaporated milk, cheese and hot sauce until melted and thick.
Warm the tortillas. Spread each with a sixth of the cheese sauce and a sixth of the beef, then roll tightly.
Toast seam-side down in a dry pan until sealed. Eat now or wrap and freeze; reheat from frozen.
recipes.notes: Recipe from the video. Calories and protein (463 cal, 52 g per burrito) are from the title; carbs and fat are estimates and depend on your tortillas.

recipes.title: Greek Yogurt Protein Cinnamon Rolls

items.i: all-purpose flour (or self-rising, then skip baking powder and salt)
sweetener of choice (brown sugar or zero-calorie)

steps: Mix the flour, yogurt, baking powder and salt for a couple of minutes until it forms a slightly sticky ball. Add a little more flour if it's very sticky.
Flatten the dough on floured parchment into a rectangle with your hands or a floured rolling pin.
Brush with butter or coconut oil, sprinkle with sweetener and a generous layer of cinnamon.
Roll it up slowly and tightly, then cut into rolls (string or floss makes clean cuts). Set them cut side up.
Mix the cream cheese, protein powder, vanilla, yogurt and any extra sweetener until smooth, and spread over the warm rolls.
recipes.notes: Amounts come from the video. The creator's full recipe and calories are on his site (linked), which I couldn't open from here, so the number of rolls, filling amounts and all macros are estimates.

recipes.title: Oreo Protein Ice Cream (Ninja Creami)

items.i: fat-free ultra-filtered milk (Fairlife or similar), plus a splash
scoop cookies & cream protein powder (e.g. Ghost Oreo)
sugar-free vanilla or cheesecake pudding mix (about 1 tbsp)

steps: Add the milk, protein powder and pudding mix to a Ninja Creami pint and mix well.
Run on the Light Ice Cream setting. Add a tiny splash of milk and Re-spin for a smoother texture.
For the cookie version, dig a hole in the middle, add the crushed cookies and run the Mix-In setting.
recipes.notes: 290 cal and 45 g protein per pint are as said in the video (before the optional cookies). Needs a Ninja Creami. Carbs and fat are estimates. Freezing time not included.

recipes.title: Crispy Lebanese Beef Pitta Wraps

items.i: other warm spices, e.g. cumin and allspice
pickles and hot sauce, to serve

steps: Finely chop the white onion, garlic, chili and parsley in a mini chopper, then squeeze out the water in a cloth.
Mix the aromatics into the beef with the paprika, pepper, salt and spices. Set aside.
Toss the red onion and parsley with sumac, salt and a drizzle of olive oil.
Mix the yogurt, grated cucumber, garlic paste, lemon juice and salt until creamy.
Split each pitta into two layers. Spread a sixth of the beef thinly over the bottom half, put the top on and press down firmly.
Toast in a pan over medium heat with cooking spray, both sides, until golden and the beef is cooked through.
Open up, add garlic sauce, crunchy salad, pickles and hot sauce, then fold into a wrap.
recipes.notes: Amounts come from the on-screen captions; 420 cal and 44 g protein per wrap are from the video title. The chili, cucumber and sumac amounts, and carbs/fat, are estimates.

recipes.title: 143-Calorie Oreo McFlurry Ice Cream (Ninja Creami)

items.i: high-protein low-calorie milk (Milk50 vanilla or original)
vanilla bean paste or extract (1 tsp)

steps: Blend all the base ingredients, pour into a Creami pint and freeze at least 16 hours.
Run the pint under hot water for at least 60 seconds.
Spin on Lite Ice Cream, then Re-spin. Re-spin again if it's still powdery.
Make a hole down to the bottom, add the crumbled Oreo Thins and run Mix-In.
recipes.notes: Recipe and whole-pint macros come from the video description. Keep the Oreo cream in if you like — it roughly doubles the cookie calories. Freezing time not included.

recipes.title: High-Protein Breakfast Crunchwraps

items.i: hash brown patties (about 46 g each), air-fried
low-fat shredded cheese (25 g per wrap)

steps: Mix the beef with the taco seasoning until it changes color.
Put a ball of beef on each mini tortilla and squash it flat to the edges.
Cook meat side down in a pan until crispy, flip, add a cheese slice and cover to melt. Repeat for all six.
In the same pan, scramble the eggs over low heat until light and fluffy.
Mix the ketchup, mayo and yogurt until smooth.
On each large tortilla: a sixth of the sauce, a crispy hash brown (broken up), eggs, chives, 25 g cheese, then a beef tortilla beef-side down.
Fold the sides in around the beef tortilla to make a crunchwrap and toast seam-side down in a pan until crispy on both sides.
Wrap in foil and freeze; reheat when you want one.
recipes.notes: Amounts come from the on-screen captions; 575 cal and 54 g protein per crunchwrap are from the video title. Carbs and fat are estimates.

recipes.title: Cheesy Beef Dipping Burritos

items.i: chicken broth (90 g plus 30 g if needed)
low-carb tortillas (La Banderita Carb Counter, 60 cal)
light string cheese sticks, frozen, halved lengthwise

steps: Blend the yogurt, cottage cheese, Taco Bell sauce and taco seasoning until smooth. Chill.
Heat the pan to 7/10. Flatten the beef, cut it in half and leave it until it browns up the sides, flip, then break it up while still slightly pink.
Add the taco seasoning packet and mix, then 90 g chicken broth and let the beef soak it up.
Turn down to 3/10. Stir in the Laughing Cow wedges, shredded cheese and nutritional yeast until creamy, adding up to 30 g more broth if it's too thick. Let it cool a little.
Spread an eighth of the beef in the middle of each tortilla and lay a string cheese half on each side.
Fold in the sides, then the bottom and top flaps, pulling tight, and press flat into a rectangle rather than rolling.
Spray and air fry 4 at a time at 400 °F for 4 minutes, flipping after 2. Serve with the sauce.
recipes.notes: Amounts come from the video's audio and on-screen captions. Macros (per burrito) are from the creator's on-screen nutrition card. They freeze well. Full recipes are in the creator's free recipe book (linked).

recipes.title: Nashville Hot Honey Chicken Crunchwrap

items.i: water (20 g + 20 g for the slurry)
½ tsp each cayenne, paprika, black pepper, sea salt, garlic powder and brown sugar
chicken breast, flattened and cut into 4 patties
Nashville seasoning: cayenne, paprika, black pepper, sea salt, garlic powder, brown sugar

steps: Mix the yogurt, mayo, vinegar, pickle juice, honey, salt and pepper until smooth, then toss in the cabbage and carrots. Chill.

Put the syrup, honey, vinegar, butter, 20 g water and spices in a pot, then heat on 5/10, stirring until it simmers. Take off the heat, stir in the cornstarch mixed with 20 g water and keep stirring until thick.
Flatten the chicken and cut out 4 even patties (cook the offcuts too).
Whisk egg whites with Frank's. Mix the flour, cornstarch, baking powder and Nashville seasoning. Dip each patty in the wet, then press into the dry, getting into every crevice.
Spray until no flour shows and air fry at 400 °F for 9 minutes, flipping and spraying after 5. Brush with warm hot honey.

Soften a tortilla in warm water, cut one slit from the middle to the edge, then fill the four quarters with chicken, slaw, pickle-brine sauce and 6 pickles. Fold each quarter over the next and press shut.
Spray and air fry at 400 °F for 5 minutes (a ramekin on top keeps it shut). Slice in half.
recipes.notes: Amounts come from the audio and on-screen captions. Macros (per crunchwrap) are from the creator's on-screen nutrition card. Spice amounts in the chicken coating are estimates.

recipes.title: Crispy Chicken Bacon Ranch Pinwheels

items.i: ranch dip mix, to season the chicken

steps: Blend the ranch ingredients 60–90 seconds until smooth. Chill.
Bake the bacon at 400 °F for 15–17 minutes, drain on paper towels and chop.
Pat the chicken dry, flatten, season both sides with ranch mix, spray and air fry at 400 °F for 9–10 minutes. Rest 10 minutes, then dice finely.
Mix the chicken, bacon, yogurt, Laughing Cow, mozzarella, ranch mix, pickles and green onion, breaking up the cheese wedges.
Spread a quarter of the filling over each tortilla, leaving an inch at the edges. Trim the round edges off, roll up tightly and cut into 6 pinwheels.
Put the pinwheels in a muffin tin and bake at 400 °F for 14–16 minutes until crispy underneath. Serve with the ranch.
recipes.notes: Amounts come from the audio and on-screen captions. Macros are from the creator's card (57 cal per pinwheel); a serving here is 4 pinwheels.

recipes.title: Crispy Jalapeño Popper Chicken Pockets

items.i: sea salt, garlic powder, onion powder
Laughing Cow light cheese wedges (or cream cheese)
flour and cold water, for the 'glue'
avocado oil spray and garlic powder

steps: Blend all the sauce ingredients until smooth. Chill (keeps 7–10 days).
Season the tenders with blackened seasoning, spray and air fry at 400 °F for 9 minutes. Dice finely.
Air fry the jalapeños at 400 °F for 5–7 minutes, then remove stems and seeds (keep seeds for more heat) and dice.
Mash the yogurt, Laughing Cow, jalapeños and ranch mix with a fork, then mix in the mozzarella, chicken, black beans, corn and pico.
Mix flour and water into a paste. Fold each tortilla half into a cone, gluing the seam.
